title: Visit Preparation and Arrival Times for Appointment Scheduling Visit Types
content:
Before a visit booked under **Appointment Scheduling**, Riverbend Regional Health asks the patient to arrive (or log in) ahead of the scheduled start, and some visit types carry fasting, escort and preparation-instruction requirements. The figures for each visit type are set out below.

## Figures by visit type

| Visit type | Arrive (or log in) before the start (minutes) | Video device check opens before the start (minutes) | Fasting before the visit (hours) | Preparation instructions sent (days before the visit) | Adult escort to drive the patient home |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 15 | 0 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | not required |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 10 | 15 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | not required |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 20 | 0 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | not required |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 30 | 0 | 4 | 3 | not required |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 15 | 0 | 0 (none) | 2 | not required |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 15 | 0 | 8 | 3 | not required |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 60 | 0 | 8 | 7 | required |

## What each column means

- **Arrive (or log in) before the start** — the minutes before the scheduled start at which the patient is asked to arrive, or to log in for a video visit.
- **Video device check opens** — the minutes before a video visit at which the device check opens; only the Telehealth Video Visit carries a figure other than 0 (15 minutes).
- **Fasting** — the hours of fasting required before the visit; 0 means no fasting.
- **Preparation instructions sent** — the days before the visit on which preparation instructions are sent; 0 means none are sent.
- **Adult escort** — whether an adult escort must drive the patient home; only the Outpatient Procedure Appointment requires one.

## Hypothetical timelines

These use invented start times only to show how the minute and hour figures read.

- *Hypothetical:* an Outpatient Procedure Appointment scheduled to start at 9:00 — the patient is asked to arrive 60 minutes before, at 8:00; fasting of 8 hours before the visit is required; preparation instructions are sent 7 days before the visit; an adult escort must drive the patient home.
- *Hypothetical:* a Telehealth Video Visit scheduled to start at 14:00 — the patient is asked to log in 10 minutes before, at 13:50, and the device check opens 15 minutes before, at 13:45.
- *Hypothetical:* a Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) scheduled to start at 10:30 — the patient is asked to arrive 30 minutes before, at 10:00, after 4 hours of fasting; preparation instructions are sent 3 days before the visit.
